title: Why Is Everyone Talking About Microsoft Stock Stock? | MSFT Stock Analysis
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; auto-captions garble names/numbers in places
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA explains why Microsoft is the talk of the market: among the big four tech spenders on AI, it is one of the only ones still generating free cash flow after nearly $200 billion of annual investment. The reason is its pragmatic follower approach to large language models — aiming to match leading models within 3–6 months of release at a fraction of the training cost, rather than paying to lead — which keeps the business cash-generative while Alphabet's free cash flow turned negative for two consecutive quarters as capex more than doubled. Microsoft is still spending aggressively where revenue follows quickly: it built 24 new data centres across five continents in the quarter against a $500 billion-plus order backlog, and demand is still accelerating on enterprise and agentic-AI adoption, including consumer agents following Meta's Muse app (10 million-plus downloads in six weeks). Its own Maya chips add to the story: Maya 200 delivers 1.7x more tokens per watt across Teams and Copilot, and Maya 300 promises 40% more tokens per watt than leading GPU systems, trading best-in-class speed for better value. Microsoft fell only about 1% after results versus Alphabet's roughly 12% drop. No explicit rating or fair value is stated, so no call-event is recorded; his prior tracked MSFT stance remains HOLD (25 October).
